title: H 3389 (118th General Assembly): Prohibit The Name Of A Candidate For President Or Vice President Of The United States Be Printed On A Ballot In South Carolina Unless There Is Shown Conclusive Proof That The Candidate Is A Natural Born Citizen Of The United States.

(section) SECTION 1 (new 7-13-315)
(quote) A candidate for President or Vice President of the United States may not have his name printed on a ballot in this State unless there is conclusive evidence that he is a natural born citizen of the United States.
(section) SECTION 1 (new 7-13-315)
(quote) This section applies to a person, petitioner, or party placing the names of electors on the ballot.
(other) SECTION 2: takes effect upon approval by the Governor.
